name: 13126-multiimage-qwen25vl72b-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, no quantization_config; ~36 GB of weights per rank at TP4.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=2, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 300 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm, ONE turn: four 1200x1200 JPEGs plus 200 tokens of text in, 16 tokens out, temperature 0.0 with `ignore_eos`. Built as FIVE data sources -- one `synthetic_text` and four `synthetic_image`, each `images_per_request: 1` with its own seed (131-134) -- because guidellm reads that count as a number of TURNS, so one source asking for four images sends a four-turn conversation instead of one four-image request.
purpose: A 72-billion-parameter catalogue assistant reading four product photos and a short question per request, two concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser, and the engine would
# then run without whatever the block declared. host / port / served-model-name are owned by the
# serving layer, which starts the server and waits for /health; writing them here would fight it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Load-bearing rather than cosmetic: a request is ~7600 tokens, so at 32000 it is admitted in ONE
# extend batch and never split across scheduler steps.
chunked-prefill-size: 32000

disable-radix-cache: true
random-seed: 42
